-- Read-only metadata projection. Source: deployed 82789 / source 3f0.
-- No credentials, secrets, provider refresh, model call, row lock or mutation.
WITH task_scope AS (
  SELECT id, "userId", "issueId", "candidateId"
  FROM factory_tasks
  WHERE id='e42571e5-58f7-40e3-9418-c02ee8843fe6'::uuid
), sources AS (
  SELECT a.id AS "attemptId", a.stage, r.id AS "runId", r."userId", r."agentId",
    r."agentDefinition"->>'harness' AS harness,
    r."agentDefinition"->>'model' AS model,
    r."agentDefinition"#>>'{executionIdentity,workspaceId}' AS "workspaceId",
    r."agentDefinition"#>>'{subscription,bindingId}' AS "frozenBindingId",
    r."agentDefinition"#>>'{subscription,modelId}' AS "subscriptionModel",
    COALESCE(NULLIF(r."agentDefinition"#>'{agentProfile,targetEntry}','null'::jsonb),
      NULLIF(r."agentDefinition"#>'{modelDispatch,entry}','null'::jsonb)) AS entry,
    r."agentDefinition" ? 'agentProfile' AS "profileKeyPresent",
    jsonb_typeof(r."agentDefinition"->'agentProfile') AS "profileJsonType",
    r."agentDefinition" ? 'apiKey' AS "apiKeyKeyPresent",
    jsonb_typeof(r."agentDefinition"->'apiKey') AS "apiKeyJsonType"
  FROM task_scope t
  JOIN factory_attempts a ON a."taskId"=t.id AND a."candidateId"=t."candidateId"
  JOIN agent_runs r ON r.id=a."runId" AND r."userId"=t."userId" AND r."issueId"=t."issueId"
  WHERE a.id IN ('41e41625-f1e2-4b2d-9d62-9fecbc4d62ae'::uuid,
                 'aa77cb0b-bb48-4c7a-ab73-ad68e7df7dba'::uuid)
)
SELECT clock_timestamp() AS "observedAt", s."attemptId", s.stage, s."runId", s."agentId",
  s.harness, s.model, s."workspaceId", s."frozenBindingId", s."subscriptionModel",
  s.entry->>'id' AS "entryId", s.entry->>'harness' AS "entryHarness",
  s.entry->>'model' AS "entryModel", s.entry#>>'{source,kind}' AS "entrySourceKind",
  s.entry#>>'{source,connectionId}' AS "entryConnectionId",
  s."profileKeyPresent", s."profileJsonType", s."apiKeyKeyPresent", s."apiKeyJsonType",
  b.id AS "currentBindingId", b."consumerId", b.route, b."workspaceId" AS "bindingWorkspaceId",
  b."connectionId", b."connectionRevision", b."modelId" AS "bindingModelId",
  (a.id IS NOT NULL) AS "sourceAgentStillOwned",
  (b."consumerId"=s."agentId"::text) AS "consumerMatchesAgent",
  (b."workspaceId"=s."workspaceId") AS "bindingWorkspaceMatches",
  (b.route=CASE s.harness WHEN 'claude_code' THEN 'claude_code_cli' WHEN 'codex' THEN 'codex_cli' END) AS "nativeRouteMatches",
  (b."connectionId"::text=s.entry#>>'{source,connectionId}') AS "frozenConnectionMatches",
  (b."modelId"=s.model AND b."modelId"=s.entry->>'model') AS "frozenModelMatches",
  (b."ownerId"<>s."userId") AS "sharedCredential",
  (c.id IS NOT NULL) AS "connectionExists", c.provider, c.state, c.paused,
  (c."removedAt" IS NOT NULL) AS removed, c.epoch AS "currentConnectionEpoch",
  (c.epoch=b."connectionRevision") AS "connectionEpochMatches",
  (c.provider=CASE s.harness WHEN 'claude_code' THEN 'claude' WHEN 'codex' THEN 'codex' END) AS "providerMatches",
  jsonb_typeof(c."modelCatalog"->'models') AS "catalogModelsType",
  COALESCE((c."modelCatalog"->'models') ? s.model, false) AS "catalogContainsFrozenModel",
  (c.quota IS NOT NULL) AS "quotaPresent"
FROM sources s
LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.id=s."agentId" AND a."userId"=s."userId"
LEFT JOIN byos_bindings b ON b.id::text=s."frozenBindingId"
LEFT JOIN byos_connections c ON c.id=b."connectionId" AND c."ownerId"=b."ownerId"
ORDER BY s.stage;
